landingFaqA1: Nassaq runs your whole school from one place — attendance, schedules, assessments, and reports — powered by AI that turns daily data into clearer decisions and saved hours.
landingFaqQ2: Is Nassaq just a traditional school system?
landingFaqA2: More than a traditional system. Nassaq pairs everyday operations with smart scheduling and the Hakim AI assistant that flags what needs attention early — so you lead your school instead of chasing it.
landingFaqQ3: What are the platform's main features?
landingFaqA3: Accurate attendance, smart drag-and-drop timetables, assessments and grading, live reports and analytics, a parent portal, instant notifications, and the Hakim AI assistant — everything your school needs in one platform.
landingFaqA4: Hakim reads student performance and engagement, surfaces who may need support before it's too late, and gives your teachers and leadership ready insights that shorten decision time.
landingFaqQ5: Does it support public and private schools?
landingFaqA5: Yes. Nassaq adapts to schools of every type and size, with settings and permissions tailored to each one.
landingFaqQ6: Is school and student data secure?
landingFaqA6: Your school's security comes first: precise role permissions, full data isolation per school, multi-factor authentication, and logging of sensitive actions. Your data is yours and stays under your control.
landingFaqQ7: Can parents follow their children through the platform?
landingFaqA7: Yes. The parent portal gives families a clear view of their children — attendance, grades, notes, and schedule — with direct teacher communication and alerts on what matters.
landingFaqA8: Yes. Nassaq runs smoothly on phone and desktop straight from the browser, so teachers and parents use it anytime, anywhere — no app to install.
landingFaqA9: Yes. Every role has its own access — principal, teacher, parent, student — so each user sees only what's relevant to them, securely and clearly.
landingFaqA10: Yes. Instant in-app notifications the moment something important happens, plus email alerts for things like invitations and password resets — so your team never misses a beat.
landingFaqQ11: Does Nassaq integrate with our current systems?
landingFaqA11: Yes. Import your students and teachers from Noor via Excel in minutes, and Nassaq works alongside your current tools like Madrasati without conflict.
landingFaqA12: Schools and independent teachers start by registering directly, while teacher, parent, and student accounts are added through school invitations or bulk import from Noor — fast to launch, fully controlled.
landingFaqA13: Yes. Nassaq is built to scale with you: manage multiple schools on one platform, each with fully isolated data.
landingFaqQ14: Does it provide reports and analytics for administrators?
landingFaqA14: Yes. Live dashboards for attendance and performance at school, teacher, and student levels, with professional PDF, Excel, and CSV exports ready to share.
landingFaqA15: Register your school now and start setup in minutes, or contact us to walk you through accounts and data import step by step.
teacherFaqQ1: What is the NASSAQ Teacher workspace?
teacherFaqA1: It's your own private space as an independent teacher — set up in minutes, with no school admin required. You create your classes, track your students, and run your day from one place.
teacherFaqQ2: How do I create and manage my classes?
teacherFaqA2: Add your classes and students directly in your workspace. Organise them however you teach — by subject, level, or group — and update rosters anytime.
teacherFaqQ3: Can I track attendance for my classes?
teacherFaqA3: Yes. Mark attendance digitally during each session — present, absent, or late — and every record is saved automatically to your students' history.
teacherFaqQ4: Can I plan my lessons in NASSAQ?
teacherFaqA4: Yes. Build and store lesson plans for your classes, keep them organised by date and subject, and revisit or reuse them whenever you need.
teacherFaqQ5: Is there a calendar to organise my schedule?
teacherFaqA5: Yes. A built-in calendar keeps your sessions and events in one view, so you always know what's coming up across your classes.
teacherFaqQ6: How do parents connect to my students?
teacherFaqA6: You invite parents to link to their child. Once linked, they can follow progress and receive the alerts you send — all under your control.
teacherFaqQ7: Can I collaborate with other teachers?
teacherFaqA7: Yes. You can invite another independent teacher to co-teach a specific class, sharing only that class while the rest of your workspace stays private.
teacherFaqQ8: Is my data separate from other teachers?
teacherFaqA8: Completely. Each teacher's workspace is fully isolated — no one sees your classes, students, or records unless you explicitly share a class for co-teaching.
teacherFaqA9: Hakim reads your daily classroom data and highlights which students may need attention, suggests next steps, and helps you draft parent messages — so you decide faster.
teacherFaqA10: Your account is protected with multi-factor authentication, and sensitive actions ask you to confirm your identity — keeping your students' data safe.
teacherFaqA11: Start with a full free month including all features, no credit card required. After that, simple monthly or annual plans keep everything you need.
teacherFaqQ12: Does it support Arabic and English?
teacherFaqA12: Yes. NASSAQ works fully in both Arabic and English with right-to-left support — switch the interface to whichever you prefer at any time.
teacherFaqQ13: Can I use it on any device?
teacherFaqA13: Yes. NASSAQ runs straight from your browser on phone, tablet, or computer — no app to install, available wherever you teach.
teacherFaqQ14: Can I export my data or pause my workspace?
teacherFaqA14: Yes. You can export your workspace data anytime, and your records stay yours — you stay in control of keeping, exporting, or closing your workspace.

landingHakimIntro3: From attendance to academic performance… I see the full picture and discover what the numbers mean.
landingJourneyStep1Subtitle: Every school produces thousands of data points daily
landingJourneyStep1Content: Recording attendance, evaluating assignments, recording behavior, student participation, test results, teacher notes. But this data is often distributed and fragmented.
landingJourneyStep1HakimSays: Schools generate thousands of data points every day... but few can turn this data into knowledge.
landingJourneyStep2Subtitle: Here is where NASSAQ platform begins
landingJourneyStep2Content: The system collects all this data in one platform: attendance, academic performance, daily behavior, in-class interaction, assignments and assessments.
landingJourneyStep2HakimSays: My mission is to organize this data and turn it into a clear picture for the school.
landingJourneyStep3Content: Discovering students who need support, analyzing behavioral patterns, tracking academic decline, identifying participation improvement opportunities.
landingJourneyStep3HakimSays: I don't just display numbers... I discover what these numbers mean.
landingJourneyStep4Content: Student support plans, performance reports, precise educational decisions based on real data that help improve education quality.
landingJourneyStep4HakimSays: Data alone doesn't change education... but the right decisions do.
landingAiCap1Subtitle: Understanding the student before problems appear
landingAiCap1Content: AI continuously analyzes attendance, participation, assignments, assessments, and behavior to discover students who need early support.
landingAiCap1HakimSays: I can detect a student who needs support... before the problem becomes an educational crisis.
landingAiCap2Subtitle: When scheduling becomes an intelligent process
landingAiCap2Content: Creating a balanced school schedule considering teachers, classes, subjects, rooms, and sessions. AI analyzes thousands of possibilities.
landingAiCap2HakimSays: I can analyze thousands of possibilities in seconds to build a balanced schedule.
landingAiCap3Subtitle: Reports you understand... not just read
landingAiCap3Content: Instead of just displaying numbers, the system transforms data into clear educational insights: class performance, student progress, behavioral patterns.
landingAiCap3HakimSays: Numbers alone aren't enough... my mission is to turn them into vision that helps the school make decisions.
landingAiCap4Content: The system continuously monitors behavior and performance patterns and sends early alerts when detecting decline in a student or entire class performance.
landingAiCap4HakimSays: Every day the school generates thousands of data points... my mission is to understand what this data means.

landingEcoRole1Content: See a complete picture of the school: student attendance, class performance, teacher activity, student behavior, performance reports.
landingEcoRole1HakimSays: Instead of searching through dozens of reports... I can display a complete picture on one screen.
landingEcoRole2Content: Record attendance, track interaction, evaluate answers, record behavior, add assessments. All in a simple and fast interface built for teaching staff across schools and universities.
landingEcoRole2HakimSays: During class... I help teaching staff understand the level of interaction in the classroom.
landingEcoRole4Title: Real follow-up on your child's performance
landingEcoRole4Content: Follow attendance, assignments, behavior, assessments through a simple and clear dashboard available anytime.
landingEcoRole4HakimSays: When parents are part of the picture... education becomes more successful.

landingPainCol2Title: Time gets spent on tracking, not teaching.
landingPainCol2Body: Teaching staff spend hours each week on administrative work that produces no real academic intervention.

landingPainCol3Body: Parents only see academic signals after they have already escalated and their impact has shown.

landingLoopHeading: How does NASSAQ work day to day?
landingLoopSubheading: Four steps that turn daily signals into clear decisions.
landingLoopStep1Body: Pulls performance, attendance and behavior from every source — automatically, daily, without manual entry.
landingLoopStep2Body: Detects deviations from a student's normal trajectory before they show up in grades — while intervention still works.
landingLoopStep3Body: Builds a clear daily intervention list for every role — admin, teacher, parent — ranked by urgency.
landingLoopStep4Body: Directly actionable recommendations, with follow-up on the impact of every intervention — so you know the improvement is real.

landingInsightFeature3Body: They reach you before the decline shows up in final results.
